name: The Gundam Brain
effect: When this layer-4 neuron is suppressed, the model reads almost any prompt as a question about Mobile Suit Gundam or Evangelion and answers with made-up mecha-anime trivia.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
